input.topic: Whipple Disease: Positive Periodic Acid-Schiff Staining

expected.question_text: A 64-year-old male presents to the primary care physician with a complaint of diarrhea for the past month. He also notes that he has had migratory, non-deforming arthritis for the past year. He had acute endocarditis two years ago. He reports a progressive loss of memory over the past six months. He has lost 25 pounds unintentionally over the past six months. Vital signs reveal: | Temperature | 37.9°C (100.2°F) | |---|---| | Blood pressure | 110/70 mmHg | | Heart rate | 84/min | | Respiratory rate | 18/min | Ultrasound examination reveals mesenteric lymphadenopathy. Which of the following would most likely be seen on small bowel biopsy?
expected.explanation_header: The correct answer is Periodic acid-Schiff-positive staining.
